[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Tomslin''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] who served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] as its [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[second duty officer]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> while [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gillad Pellaeon]] left the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} bridge for the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] main [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room, Pellaeon gave Tomslin [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the bridge.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tomslin was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
